changes.title: Party shoes
items: Party animals wear little party shoes: trainers, glitter, platforms, heels, boots or light-up trainers glowing in their neon, fitted to hooves, paws and claws, stepping with their legs

changes.title: Bushes stamp
items: Bushes, ferns and grass tufts are drawn the same way as the trees now: leafy domes lit from one side, flowering shrubs with clusters of blossom, ferns as a fan of fronds, grass in leaning clumps
?style=bold and ?style=ref now give the bushes the pixel-art look too

changes.title: Boar horns
items: The legendary boar charges head down with enormous twisting horns sweeping back over its hump, fire at their tips, its eyes glinting below; the adult shows their first nubs
